raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. often P~, elected head of government in many republics, Presiden: the P~ of Indonesia, Presiden Indonesia; 2. also P~, head of association, club, etc, Presiden, Yang Dipertua; ( of academic institution ) presiden: she was elected ~ of the History Society, dia dipilih menjadi Presiden Persatuan Sejarah; he was unanimously elected as college ~, dia dgn sebulat suara dipilih menjadi presiden kolej itu; 3. ( esp US) head of company, bank, etc, presiden: ~ of Petronas, presiden Petronas. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
